select * from(
SELECT distinct case when fpa.is_cycle='Y' then @rownum:=@rownum+1 else 1 end as idx, info.finprod_id as prodId, info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS fprodId, case when fpa.is_lay='Y' and fpa.is_cycle='N' then 'Y' else 'N' end as isLay, rul.EFF_DATE AS changeDate, null as cashmdate, info.PROFIT_TYPE as profitType, '01' changType, rul.YIELD AS prodYield, null as prodBenchmarkRate, null as unitValueTotal, null as unitValue, null as sevenDayRate, IFNULL(rul.UPDATE_TIME,rul.CREATE_TIME) updatetime, if ( (@FINPROD_MARKET_ID = info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID and @EFF_DATE= rul.EFF_DATE), @rank := @rank + 1, @rank :=1) as idx, @FINPROD_MARKET_ID := info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, @EFF_DATE := rul.EFF_DATE FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE rul left JOIN FIN_PRODUCT info on info.FINPROD_ID=rul.FINPROD_ID left JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_add fpa on fpa.FINPROD_ID=rul.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO B ON rul.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID WHERE 1=1 and info.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F16','F24') AND info.PROFIT_TYPE = '02' and B.CASH_TYPE_1 = '02' AND rul.BRANCH=0 and b.branch = 0 /*取母产品报价*/ and IFNULL(rul.UPDATE_TIME,rul.CREATE_TIME) > #{updatetime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} order by rul.UPDATE_TIME desc union all
select distinct 1 as idx, info.finprod_id as prodId, info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS fprodId, null as isLay, val.VAL_DATE as changeDate, null as cashmdate, info.PROFIT_TYPE as profitType, '02' changType, null AS prodYield, null as prodBenchmarkRate, val.TOTAL_NET_VALUE as unitValueTotal, val.NET_UNIT_VALUE as unitValue, val.SEVEN_DAY_RATE as sevenDayRate, IFNULL(val.UPDATE_TIME,val.CREATE_TIME) updatetime from bok_valbal_table_status val LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT info on info.FINPROD_ID = val.FINPROD_ID where info.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' AND info.PROFIT_TYPE in ('01','03')
and val.NOTICE_STATUS = '1'
and val.CONFIRM_STATUS = '1'
and (val.NOTICE_STATUS is null or val.NOTICE_STATUS != '1') and (val.CONFIRM_STATUS is null or val.CONFIRM_STATUS != '1')
and IFNULL(val.UPDATE_TIME,val.CREATE_TIME) > #{updatetime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
union all SELECT distinct case when fpa.is_cycle='Y' then @rownum:=@rownum+1 else 1 end as idx, info.finprod_id as prodId, info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS fprodId, case when fpa.is_lay='Y' and fpa.is_cycle='N' then 'Y' else 'N' end as isLay, rul.EFF_DATE AS changeDate, plan.E_ACCR_DATE as cashmdate, info.PROFIT_TYPE as profitType, '03' changType, null AS prodYield, rul.rate as prodBenchmarkRate, null as unitValueTotal, null as unitValue, null as sevenDayRate, IFNULL(rul.UPDATE_TIME,rul.CREATE_TIME) updatetime, if ( (@FINPROD_MARKET_ID = info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID and @EFF_DATE= rul.EFF_DATE), @rank := @rank + 1, @rank :=1) as idx, @FINPROD_MARKET_ID := info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, @EFF_DATE := rul.EFF_DATE FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO rul left JOIN FIN_PRODUCT info on info.FINPROD_ID=rul.FINPROD_ID left JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_add fpa on fpa.FINPROD_ID=rul.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE_DETAIL detail on rul.base_rule_id=detail.base_rule_id left join FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE plan on detail.cash_id=plan.cash_id WHERE 1=1 and info.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F16','F24') AND info.PROFIT_TYPE in ('01','03') AND rul.BRANCH=0 and rul.base_rule_type='02' and IFNULL(rul.UPDATE_TIME,rul.CREATE_TIME) > #{updatetime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} order by rul.UPDATE_TIME desc ) a where 1=1 and a.idx=1
